Commentary.Commentary: Right! 147 is what England need to win. They chase down a bigger target in their last game and would back themselves to knock this one down as well and take an unassailable lead in the 3-match T20I series. South Africa, on the other hand, would look to strike early and take the game deep. Let's see how it pans out when the run chase begins in a short while.

England were decent with the ball throughout. They kept chipping away at wickets and never allowed the Protea batters to settle. Archer was the one who struck first for them. Rashid was superb in his spell, picking up two wickets and giving away just 23. However, in the last 3 overs, they gave away 34 runs and that won't please them as they had the chance of restricting the opposition to an even smaller total.

Earlier in the game, England won the toss and asked the hosts to set up the total. De Kock and Bavuma added 33 quickly but both failed to continue and got out in quick succession. Reeza and du Plessis too failed to provide any sort of value to their innings. Rassie van der Dussen along with Linde added 44 runs for the 6th wicket and helped the team get close to 150. Linde played an important hand as he scored 29 off just 20 deliveries.

34 runs in the last 3 overs for the Proteas and they would think that they have got something to bowl for. Credit to van der Dussen and Linde for playing a few good shots during their good stand that has taken South Africa close to 150.

Full on middle, Rabada looks to go big but misses it. The batsmen try to steal a bye. It goes towards the keeper where Buttler goes for a direct hit at his end but misses it. The batsmen steal a bye in the end. SOUTH AFRICA END WITH 146/6!
FOUR! Shot! Another useful boundary. Full and wide outside off, Rabada drills it over extra cover and finds the fence.
Yorker outside off, Rabada looks to dig it out but misses it.
Full on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on middle, van der Dussen looks to slog but gets hit on the pads.
Full toss on middle, Rabada lofts it over mid on. The fielder at long on collects it on one bounce. The batsmen cross ends.
Kagiso Rabada is the new batsman in.

OUT! RUN OUT! The dive doesn't save Linde! A fuller ball outside off, Linde drives it towards mid off. Stokes misfields. He tries to get up and slips again. The batters take two and go for the third but by that time Stokes recovers and throws the ball to the bowler. Jordan takes the bails off quickly. The third umpire has been called for. One replay confirms that Linde is short. A fine knock from him though and it has given South Africa something to bowl at.
Is that a run out? Let's see what the replays have to show. Yes. Gone.
Full delivery on off, van der Dussen drives it towards mid off for a run.
Full on off, Linde pushes it through covers for a single.
Full on middle, Linde flicks it through square leg. Two runs taken.
Back of a length on off, Linde pushes it through mid on for a couple.
FOUR! Good shot! Full ball on off, Linde guides it fine towards third man for a boundary. Perfect start to the over.
Chris Jordan to bowl out. 3-0-17-1 from him. Can South Africa manage to hit a couple of boundaries or so in this over?
Full delivery on off, Linde drives it through point for a single. 15 off the over. A good one for the hosts.
SIX! That is huge! Short ball on middle, Linde pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! That is smashed! Full ball on off, Linde lofts it over covers for a boundary. Much needed boundary for the Protea.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen pushes it towards covers for a run.
Full delivery on off, Linde drives it towards mid off for a single.
WIDE! Full and outside off, Linde leaves it alone. It is wided by the umpire.
Length ball on middle, van der Dussen flicks it through square leg for a single.
Bowling change! Tom Curran is back for his 3rd. 2-0-16-1 from him so far.
Short delivery on off, Linde cuts it to point.
WIDE! Archer bowls a bouncer, Linde does well to duck under it.
Good length delivery on off, Linde blocks it off the back foot.
Full ball on off, Linde keeps it out.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen guides it towards third man for a single.
Length ball on middle, Linde pushes it through mid on for a single.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen guides it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen punches it through point for a single.
Length delivery on off, van der Dussen punches it to mid off.
WIDE! Jordan bowls it down the leg side, Rassie lets it go. Wided by the umpire.
Full delivery on off, Linde drives it through covers for a single.
Full on middle, Linde looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen punches it through covers for a run.
Full and on middle, flicked wide of the long on fielder for a couple of runs.
Chris Jordan is back on. 2-0-11-1 from him so far.
Short ball on middle, van der Dussen pulls it hard down to dep square leg for one. Just 5 from the over.
Full on middle, Linde flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen punches it through covers for a run. 100 up for South Africa!
Length delivery on off, Linde pushes it through point for a single.
Full on middle, Linde looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
Full on middle, Linde pushes it through mid on for a single.
Rashid is done with his 4 overs. Here's Jofra Archer. 2-0-9-1 from him so far.
Length ball on middle, Linde pushes it towards mid on for a run. End of a successful over from Tom Curran.
Back of a length on middle, Linde flicks it through square leg for a couple.
George Linde walks in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust. Klaasen is the latest casuality for the South Africans. A short ball from Curran, he rolls his fingers around. Klaasen looks to pull but it comes off the toe end of the bat and goes to Stokes at mid-wicket. He is not going to drop these. Hlaf the side back in the hut for the Proteas with score not even crossing 100.
Short ball on middle, van der Dussen pulls it through square leg for a run.
Full on middle, Klaasen flicks it through square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle, van der Dussen pushes it towards mid on for a single.
Change in bowling. Tom Curran returns. Went for 11 in his first over. Can he improve his figures?
Single to end the over. Full and around off, it is poked towards point for one. Rashid ends his spell. 2/23 in his 4 overs.
Full and around off, eased down to long off for one.
FIVE WIDES! Down the leg side, Klaasen looks to sweep but misses it. It goes past the keeper towards fine leg for a boundary.
Full delivery on off, Klaasen drives it to covers.
Flighted ball on off, van der Dussen pushes it towards third man for a run.
Floated delivery on off, Klaasen pushes it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, van der Dussen pushes it through mid on for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Klaasen pulls it through square leg for a couple.
Length ball on middle, van der Dussen flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Length delivery on off, Klaasen pushes it through covers for a run.
Short ball on middle, van der Dussen pulls it through square leg for a run.
Full delivery on off, van der Dussen pushes it to covers.
Back of a length on off, van der Dussen keeps it out.
Change in bowling. Chris Jordan is back on. 1-0-6-1 from him so far.
Flat and on middle, Rassie tucks it towards square leg and keeps the strike for the next over.
Full and on middle, pushed towards point.
Full delivery on off, Klaasen drives it through covers for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Klaasen pushes it to covers.
Tossed up delivery on off, Klaasen defends it off the front foot.
Heinrich Klaasen is in at no. 6.

OUT! STUMPED! Sharp from Buttler behind the wickets. Rashid gets the big man. Lovely loopy ball from him. Faf is drawn forward and he tries to drive but the ball breaks away just a little. But it is good enough to beat the outside edge. Buttler collects the ball and takes the bails off in a flash. No need to go upstairs as the square leg umpire raises his finger. South Africa are throwing away a good start here.
Full ball on off, Rassie plays it to point. 10 from the 10th over. South Africa are 75/3 at the halfway mark!
Short delivery on middle, van der Dussen pulls it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length delivery on off, Rassie keeps it out.
WIDE! Stokes bowls a bouncer, van der Dussen ducks under it. Wided.
Length delivery on off, van der Dussen guides it towards third man for a couple.
Back of a length on off, du Plessis pushes it towards covers for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! Length delivery on middle, du Plessis lofts it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Rassie van der Dussen is in now.

OUT! TIMBER! Rashid gets his man now! After getting hit for a boundary on the last ball he gets the revenge. He tosses this up and bowls it on the stumps line. Reeza gets down to sweep but fails to connect. The ball goes behind and disturbs the stumps. England continue to strike.
FOUR! Good shot! Flatter outside off, Hendricks plays a reverse sweep towards third man for a boundary.
On middle, Hendricks sweeps it to mid-wicket.
Floated ball on middle, Hendricks looks to sweep but gets an inside edge. It goes past the stumps towards the keeper.
Full delivery on off, Hendricks drives it through covers. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, du Plessis pulls it through wide mid on for a single.
Short delivery on middle, Hendricks pulls it towards the leg side.
Length ball on off, Hendricks plays it to covers.
Full on middle, du Plessis flicks it through square leg for a single.
Length delivery on off, Hendricks punches it through covers for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled to deep mid-wicket for one.
Short ball outside off to begin from Stokes, Reeza punches it through point for one.
Ben Stokes is on now.
Dot to end the over! Just 4 from Rashid's first. Full and outside off, du Plessis drills the drive but finds the cover fielder.
On middle, Hendricks punches it through mid on for a run.
Floated on middle, du Plessis flicks it through square leg for a run.
Short ball on middle, Hendricks pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted on middle, du Plessis flicks it through square leg for a run.

Huge appeal for caught down the leg side but not out says the umpire. Floated on middle and leg, Faf looks to work it on the leg side but misses. Buttler takes the catch and appeals but nothing form the umpire. Not given wide which means that the umpire thinks it kissed the pad on its way to the keeper.
Adil Rashid is on.
England have managed to pull back things nicely after that attack from de Kock.
Full on middle, du Plessis drives it through mid on for a run. End of the Powerplay! South Africa are 50/2 after 6 overs!
Back of a length on off, Hendricks punches it towards mid off for a run.
Full on middle, Hendricks flicks it to mid-wicket.
Length delivery on off, du Plessis punches it to point.
Faf du Plessis is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Very good catch from Tom and that is end of de Kock's little innings. A fuller ball around off, de Kock looks to slam it over the off side but the ball takes the toe end and goes high in the air towards mid on. Tom backtracks and manages to clinge on the over his head. Fine take from him. Jordan with the nack of getting wickets gets the big fish.
FOUR! Jordan is welcomed with a boundary. A harmless short ball from him to good-looking de Kock. He swivels and pulls it over square leg for a boundary.
Single to end the 5th over. Short ball on middle, pulled to fine leg for one. 11 off elder Curran's first over.
Short and outside off, punched to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Glanced away! Fine way to open the account from Reeza. Tom strays on the pads, Hendricks just helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
Goes for the mighty pull again. Mistimes it through square leg for one.
FOUR! Pulled away! A slower bouncer from Tom but the line is down the leg side. De Kock goes after it and pulls it over leaping Archer at short fine leg.
Full and outside off to begin from Tom. De Kock drives it well but finds mid off.
Tom Curran is into the attack.
Brilliant bouncer to end the over. Archer is fired up. He runs in and bangs it short and on middle. Reeza sways away from the firing line. End of a successful over from Archer.
Good length and around off, blocked.
Reeza Hendricks is the new batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! Archer gets his man. England get the first wicket. Fast and straight from Archer. Bavuma looks to slog it on the leg side but he misses it completely. The ball goes behind and makes the mess of the woodwork. Maybe an inside edge on that one. Archer and England won't care.
Back of a length and around off, kept out.
FOUR! Drilled through the covers! Full and outside off, Temba leans into the drive and nails it through the covers. It races away for a boundary.
Excellent running! Short and wide outside off, de Kock slaps it through point. The fielder from the ring gives it a chase and saves a run.
Two to end the over. Short and on middle, Bavuma pulls it wide of the fine leg fielder for a couple of runs. Massive over for the South Africans as they get 17 off it.

FOUR! Bavuma shows his innovative skills now! This is brilliant batting from these two. Sam bowls the length ball outside off, Bavuma gets across and scoops it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Punches the next short ball outside off to deep point for one.
SIX! Take that! This one goes all the way! What a strike. Short and on middle and leg, it sits up nicely for the pull. De Kock once again moves inside and powers it over fine leg for a huge six.

FOUR! Nicely done! Smart from de Kock. He knows that the fine leg fielder is inside the ring. Gets a length ball on middle, moves inside the crease and paddles it over Archer at short fine leg. A boundary.
Short and outside off, de Kock looks to pull but he is early to the shot. Mistimes it towards mid on.
A sharp bouncer to end the over! Just 2 off it. Great start from Archer. It is just outside off, good height too. Bavuma sways away from the line.
Good length and around off, Temba keeps it out.
De Kock goes for the pull but the ball is not that short. He mistimes it towards deep square leg off the inner half for one.
Shortish and on middle and leg, tucked on the leg side.
Full and around middle, de Kock drives it well but fails to beat mid on to his right.
Back of a length ball around off, Bavuma pokes it towards backward point for one.
Jofra Archer to bowl from the other end.
Single to end the opening over. 7 off it. Fullish and outside off, it is pushed through backward point for a single.
Shortish and around off, pushed towards the off side for a quick single.

Good running! Length ball around off, it is pushed towards short third man. They go for the quick single. Rashid there fires the throw at the striker's end but he misses. They get an overthrow as well.

A length ball outside off, de Kock lifts it over cover and gets a brace to open his account. The ball stopped a bit on the surface and de Kock hit it off the upper part of the bat. Just managed to clear the fielder there.
Beaten first up! Nice line and length. Just around off and on a good length. This one comes back in after pitching. De Kock looks to defend but is beaten for the inside edge.
Bavuma is up and running on the first ball. A length ball around off, Bavuma pushes it on the off side and calls for a qucik single.

Done and dusted with all the pre-game proceedings. Time for the action. We are all set to begin. The England players are out in the middle. Temba Bavuma and Quinton de Kock will open the innings for South Africa. Sam Curran will start the proceedings for England. Here we go...
Time for the National Anthems before the action begins! First up is of England, the visitors. Now, its time for the South African National Anthem.

Chris Jordan is caught for a quick chat before the action unfolds! The all-rounder says that it was a good game for them on Friday. Adds that they relaxed on Saturday and worked out their plans for doing even better in this game. On him bowling in the death, Jordan says that in T20Is, one will get hit for the sixes but adds that he is ready to bowl anytime the captain wants him to.

South Africa (Playing XI) - Quinton de Kock (WK/C), Temba Bavuma, Faf du Plessis, Rassie van der Dussen, Heinrich Klaasen, Reeza Hendricks (IN FOR PITE VAN BILJON), George Linde, Kagiso Rabada, Lungi Ngidi, Anrich Nortje (IN FOR BEURAN HENDRICKS), Tabraiz Shamsi.
England (Unchanged Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (WK), Dawid Malan, Jonny Bairstow, Ben Stokes, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Curran, Tom Curran, Jofra Archer, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid.

South Africa skipper, Quinton de Kock, says that they have got two changes. Beuran is not playing and Nortje replaces him. The Protea skipper forgets the second change. De Kock says that they didn't do things too bad and wants to just play well. Feels England played better than them and won. Tells that they need to be clever with their plans. Says that the wicket is looking good to bat on. The second change for them is Pite van Biljon who makes way for Reeza Hendricks.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan, says that the conditions look good and hopes for a good game of cricket. Says that the wind if comes can play a big part here. Feels it will be a high-scoring game. They are playing the same XI.
TOSS - Time for the flip of the coin! Up it and goes and it lands in England's favor! They will bowl first.

Cricket, cricket and more cricket! That's how Super Sunday has been. And we are ready with another encounter. Game 2 of the 3-match series between South Africa and England. It was England who went past the Protea challenge in the first encounter and they would be roaring to take the unassailable lead here. The South Africans will be eager to bounce back and level the series. How will things pan out? We will soon find out. Stay with us for the toss and team updates.
